The '''Farfeld system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Jjannex sector/Legends|Jjannex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Farfeld II]].

==History==
It was the site of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[System Patrol Squadron]] base guarded by the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] ''[[Olrac Etnom]]'' and [[Cutlass (CR90 corvette)|''Cutlass'']] until it was destroyed by [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]].
